pages.title: Fusions
pages.text: An infusion reforges one thing. A $(l)fusion$() binds two.$(br2)Offer the first item at the altar as usual, but hold the second in your $(l)other hand$(). Both are consumed, and what rises from the altar keeps the first item's enchantments, wear and stored mana.$(br2)Fused garb still counts toward the full $(l)Arcanist's Garb$().

pages.title: Warded Robe
pages.text: The Arcanist's Robe and the Warding Amulet, made one. While worn, it turns aside $(l)30%$() of harm, paid for in mana.$(br2)$(l)Offer:$() Arcanist's Robe$(br)$(l)Other hand:$() Warding Amulet$(br)$(l)Mana:$() 120

pages.name: Fusion: Warded Robe
pages.text: Candles on each side, Obsidian on each diagonal, Lapis Blocks three out on each side.

pages.title: Crowned Hood
pages.text: Vael's crown, sewn into your hood. While worn, corruption $(l)cannot harm you$() and your mana returns $(l)twice as fast$().$(br2)$(l)Offer:$() Arcanist's Hood$(br)$(l)Other hand:$() The Sovereign's Crown$(br)$(l)Mana:$() 200

pages.name: Fusion: Crowned Hood
pages.text: Candles on each side, Crying Obsidian on each diagonal, Voidstone three out on each side, Amethyst Blocks three out on each diagonal.

pages.title: Wellspring Wand
pages.text: A Focus Wand with a Mana Crystal for a heart. It holds $(l)300 mana$() of its own and spends that first. Sneak and right-click to pour your mana in, or charge it in a Mana Battery.$(br2)$(l)Offer:$() Mana Crystal$(br)$(l)Other hand:$() Focus Wand$(br)$(l)Mana:$() 150

pages.name: Fusion: Wellspring Wand
pages.text: Candles on each side, Amethyst on each diagonal, Glimmerstone three out on each side, Lapis three out on each diagonal.

pages.title: Skystrider Boots
pages.text: Soar, bound into leather. While worn, $(l)double-tap jump$() to fly, spending 2 mana each second in the air. No spell needed.$(br2)$(l)Offer:$() Arcanist's Boots$(br)$(l)Other hand:$() Phantom Membrane$(br)$(l)Mana:$() 200$(br)You must know $(l)Soar$().

pages.name: Fusion: Skystrider Boots
pages.text: Candles on each side, Amethyst on each diagonal, Lapis three out on each side, Glimmerstone three out on each diagonal.
